name: study 170, the second clean study: 2,500 blind laws free of N on the eight starts in five batches of 500, every gate on from 256 with the learned let-through
question: The operator's question (2026-10-13): can simple local rules make a graph grow a real dimension, like space; which keep one they are given; and can the null map predict a law before it runs? Study 169 is the first study on the final probes, the installed table and the deterministic fleet (800 to 806), run on 813, its data the first clean data (the operator, 2026-11-19 21:11: "This way, we immediately have clean data from our latest codebase").

decided.size: 2,500 laws in five batches of 500, for an overnight block of about 12 hours on the host (the operator, 2026-11-20 00:50: "a 12h block of walltime available for study 170, so perhaps 5 batches of 500?"); the mean-degree cap at 32 and the ladder to 65,536 as 169's
decided.gate_shares: every gate on from 256 with the learned let-through: 10% of what a gate would withhold goes one size on, 1% once 100 in a row were withheld again a size up (the operator, 2026-11-20 00:50, asked as choices with study 169's gates' ledger of 23:38Z)
decided.drawn: five search seeds drawn with Python's secrets.randbits(63) at 2026-11-20T00:31:26Z; the grid, the starts, the budgets and the rest of the engine block are 169's, the operator having fixed none of them
